decision_rationale: The record describes a plant-oriented genomic foundation model pretrained on 10.84 billion nucleotides from 12 plant species and explicitly used for sequence generation. It also reports de novo design of novel plant genes, supporting both generative and foundation-model characteristics.
evidence_snippet: "supports long-context (64 kb) prediction and sequence generation within a unified architecture"; "pretrained on 10.84 billion nucleotides from 12 plant species"; "de novo design of novel candidates"
